status.en: 2 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Bangui, Bambouti and Balaka.
status.nb: 2 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Bangui, Bambouti og Balaka.

summary.en: Armed clashes continue in Bangui among government forces, former Séléka rebels, Anti-balaka militias, Russian Wagner troops and Africa Corps, while regional troops struck ISWAP positions in the Lake Chad basin, killing 16 fighters including senior leader Abu Zubiru. Chad is now hosting hundreds of thousands of Sudanese refugees, extending the regional humanitarian crisis, and Darfur refugees are seeing their children grow up in the same camps. The CAR war crimes court is facing collapse, threatening accountability for past atrocities. Interconnected conflicts across the region are reshaping security dynamics, adding pressure to the already fragile situation. The conflict caused 246 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
